The Lok Sabha passed the Viksit Bharat G RAM G Bill amid protests and ruckus from the opposition, who slammed the Centre for removing Mahatma Gandhi's name from the rural jobs scheme; activists have warned of protests and demanded the rollback of the bill. Meanwhile, India's economic growth has surpassed 8%, according to PM Modi, who condoled the death of Statue of Unity creator Ram Sutar; India has also signed a historic FTA with Oman and received the 'Order of Oman' for the Prime Minister.
